target: Raspberry Pi 4B native ZealOS, PWM1 analog audio isolation diagnostic
change: Added paudiobeep shell command. It calls the Pi PWM beep backend directly for 500 ms, bypasses ZealC Sound/Beep, then prints paudio status.

card_update.verified: The staged kernel and build/pi-desktop-esp/boot/kernel.elf were byte-for-byte identical before safe eject.
card_update.scope_note: Only boot/kernel.elf was intentionally updated. The current build source archive has changed since the card’s prior source archive; this kernel-only diagnostic does not claim the full boot payload matches.

manual_test.output: 3.5 mm TRRS jack; use powered speakers or a headphone amplifier because the jack is line-level.
manual_test.expected: A 440 Hz tone for about 0.5 seconds, then beep_calls=1, tone_calls=2, note=60 and hz=440. last_sta records the sample after enable; the live control and data fields are read after mute.
manual_test.interpretation: The direct command reached the PWM driver independently of ZealC Sound/Beep. The PWM sample contained the bus error flag, with neither channel reporting transmission. The error could have been latched before the sample.

limitations: HDMI audio is supported by Pi 4 hardware but not implemented by this bare-metal ZealOS build.
No ZealOS software volume control is implemented for the Pi PWM backend.

next_candidate.change: Pace MMIO writes by 10 microseconds, clear sticky PWM errors before programming a tone, and print PWM status, control and data readbacks captured after enabling both channels.
next_candidate.verification: Pi boot image layout and active PWM diagnostic output passed local checks.
next_candidate.state: Physical test completed. A slight click or buzz was heard, without a sustained tone.

card_update.verification: All seven boot payload files match build/pi-desktop-esp. Both replaced files are backed up and hash-verified.

observed.audible_result: Brief click or buzz as audio switched on and off.
observed.interpretation: The duty registers and both enable bits latched. The early sample had the bus-error flag and no transmitting bits. The diagnostic then stopped polling on the error, so this sample does not describe the full half-second interval.

plld_candidate.change: Use PLLD divided by six for 125 MHz. Keep polling despite an early bus error and report status after W1C, before channel enable, and before mute.
plld_candidate.state: All seven boot payload files matched the validated build. ZEALPI unmounted and safely ejected. The physical test was subsequently performed on the desktop HID follow-up kernel with the same audio backend.

physical_analog_acceptance.scope: Audible stock ZealC Beep through the native analog PWM path. HDMI audio remains a separate, unimplemented backend.
